A '''Dark Jedi''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Card" /> At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Note">The ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion set is set during the timeframe of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]].</ref> the Chiss was confronted by at least two enemies. During the skirmish, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] used the Force to unleash a [[Force Shockwave|destructive wave of energy]] against his foes. He had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The Chiss wore black and brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Card" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Dark Jedi appeared on the card "Force Shockwave" from the [[2008]] ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="Card" /> He was drawn by [[Lan Jun Kang]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
